decisions.reason: Changing the physical breakout pitch to 1.27 mm does not alter the ESP32-S3 GPIO assignments or pin-availability policy.
The breakout-hole pitch does not change the I2C pull-ups, series resistors, bus speed, or interboard cable assumptions.
The BOOT and reset circuit remains unchanged by the physical pitch selected for the full-pin breakout.
The panel-control connectors and GPIO mappings are independent of the ESP32 breakout pitch.
The 1.27 mm value applies to the ESP32 through-hole breakout, not the separate JST-PH battery connector.
The breakout pitch does not affect the standalone USB regulator, power capacity, source selection, or powered load.
The AXP2101 battery and USB power-path topology is unaffected by the ESP32 breakout pitch.
The source changes the ESP32 breakout pitch, not any sensor-board connector type, pitch, pinout, or count.
The physical breakout pitch does not alter the monitored rails, monitoring IC, channel allocation, or measurement placement.
Although the breakout occupies main-board layout space, selecting 1.27 mm pitch does not necessarily change any recorded board dimensions, placement, connector architecture, or hole-placement policy.
The ESP32 breakout pitch does not change the LED supply voltage, direct data drive, or level-shifter requirement.
The physical breakout pitch does not change the USB-C programming interface or native USB behavior.
